reason: A is the better, though incomplete, proposal because dilute W solid-solution strengthening in a refractory BCC alloy is physically plausible and broadly consistent with the elevated-temperature strength of W-containing HEAs. B's central claim of coherent Zr-rich nanoprecipitates is unsupported—and conflicts with its cited evidence showing Zr-containing alloys remained single-phase BCC—while its precise strength gain is speculative and precipitate stability at 1273 K is not established.
